notes.title: Chapter V
notes.content: [p]It's the 24th of July, precipitation anomaly swallowed the city with the layer of dank alienation. Suzen wake up with a feeling of tremulous anticipation - the day she has been striving for has arrived. The prey comes out to hunt.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45069826/460da4cd8257780395b9f9711a3772072458e3f2.png"][/img][/p][p]Fixes/additions: [/p][p]- Browsing pages and galleries is now more intuitive and convenient[/p][p]- A page selection bar has been added[/p][p]- Steam Overlay support has been integrated[/p][p]- Custom cursors have been added [/p][p]- Text corrections [/p][p]- Bonus for completionists: a brand new achievement system. What is not a reason for returning to the faded streets of Rewolborough?[/p]

notes.title: Chapter IV
notes.content:
Hi everyone, this is author tyioronmoor here.
I'm glad to announce that finally the new chapter is completely finished and published.
In this chapter you will see new characters, some action and betrayal.

P. S. I would appreciate it if you would tell your friends about REWOLBOROUGH. It will give me a boost if more people know about my manga.

notes.title: 📢 THE DEMO IS OUT!
notes.content:
I'm happy to announce that the first chapter of [b]The Awakening[/b] is now available separately as a [b]demo[/b] on the main [b]REWOLBOROUGH VOL.1[/b] page on Steam!

Thank you in advance for taking the time to read my manga, your tyioronmoor.
